_readme: Wan 2.2 VACE Fun (pose) on fal: tracked motion drives a first frame. Same shape as wan-3.0.json.
No brand, product, person or format word appears in this file.
label: Wan 2.2 VACE Fun (pose)
sources: fal pricing API: 0.15 USD a second (2026-11-09)

limits.inputs: video_url (the motion clip; preprocess=true tracks its poses), first_frame_url, ref_image_urls, prompt, negative_prompt
limits.safety: enable_safety_checker false needs an authorised fal account; ours is checked: a bikini first frame is refused, and a prompt can be refused

tests.what: 14 s at 480p, the swipe's poses driving our first frame
tests.result: motion copied frame for frame; the cast drifted without character sheets (blindfolds and clothes moved between people)

lip_sync.why: the pose route carries no voices, so a take made on it is silent; our read is laid on and the speaker's face is made to speak it
lip_sync.tested: [own test 2026-11-09] a 2.5 s close-up of one face, our read of one line; match = how closely the mouth's opening follows the voice's loudness, frame by frame (MediaPipe jawOpen against the read, 0 none to 1 exact); the clip as made scored 0.13
lip_sync.latentsync: fal-ai/latentsync, 0.005 USD a second, 86 s for 2.5 s: match 0.39, the closest; mouth a little soft. The house default (`take.py lipsync`)
lip_sync.sync: fal-ai/sync-lipsync/v2 (lipsync-2), 3 USD a minute, 71 s: match 0.31; the sharpest mouth shapes (a round 'oo', teeth); it re-mouths every face in frame
lip_sync.musetalk: fal-ai/musetalk, about 0.0125 USD a second of clip, 24 s: match 0.20; the mouth area goes blurry
lip_sync.limits: one face at a time: a take with several people is synced line by line on a window where the speaker's face is the largest in frame; a face turned away or under a blindfold gives nothing to sync (the first test on a wide tracked take moved no visible mouth)

animate.model: Wan 2.2 Animate on fal (fal-ai/wan/v2.2-14b/animate/move and /replace), 0.08 USD a second at 480p
animate.tested: [own test 2026-11-09] 4 s of a swipe with one woman walking and leaning in, our rater's picture as the person; move 260 s, replace 371 s
animate.move: our person does the clip's motion in our picture's place: the motion carries; the rest of the frame warps and smears where the clip's other people move
animate.replace: our person is put into the clip itself: the clip's other people, its on-screen words (garbled) and its props stay, so a swipe leaks through; usable only on a clip that is ours
animate.house: not a take route; for one person's motion onto our picture, the pose route with a tracked clip keeps the frame cleaner
